name: Rokujou Chris
source:
She is the student council president of Houshou Academy, but she is being polite to Kou and the others at the same time.

She is calm, collected, and well-mannered; even Gilbert dares not defy her. Although she is a Designer's Child, she is also a second generation who accepted computerized processing.

She was in danger when they first met and was rescued by Kou; as a return favor, she has  tried to resolve the conflict with Houshou. However, she seems to be hiding some secret and has no trust in Ark Industries...

Due to a certain incident when she was young, her family was separated, and she was taken in by the Rokujo family to be raised. Details are unknown, but it seems to be related to Chris's background…
